title: Cat-Cow Stretch (Marjaryasana-Bitilasana)
instructions: In tabletop position, inhale arching back downward, exhale rounding spine upward smoothly.
benefits: Mobilizes lumbar spine, relieves lower back tension, safe for post-op early rehabilitation.

title: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
instructions: Wide stance, turn front foot out 90 degrees, bend front knee over ankle, extend arms parallel to floor.
benefits: Builds quad and hip endurance, improves balance and ankle joint stability.

title: Child's Pose (Balasana)
instructions: Kneel on mat, big toes touching, lower torso down between thighs, forehead resting on floor.
benefits: Deep nervous system relaxation, hip opener, lowers elevated stress index.
